notes: A FULL VISUAL AND BRANDING REVIEW, ACTED ON. Three independent reviewers went over the design, the screens and the printed documents; everything they found is fixed here. YOUR DOCUMENTS ARE GUARANTEED TO CARRY YOUR OWN NAME. Sixteen printed letterheads — payment vouchers, payslips, the GRA withholding certificates your payees file, the VAT return, Excel exports — read the organisation's name directly from the record. A company that had not yet entered its own name could therefore print and file paper headed by the software's internal name. Vouchers print while still in DRAFT, before the go-live check that catches this, so the door was guarded but not shut. It is shut now, and a test refuses any future document that skips the check. EASIER ON THE EYES. Column headings, hints and placeholders sat below the accepted contrast standard — the smallest text in the app, and the text you read for hours. They are darker now. The primary button also failed contrast in dark mode; corrected. CLEARER SCREENS. Delete is red and no longer looks identical to Post. Money column headings sit over their figures. One date format everywhere — 04 Aug 2026 — the same on every computer, instead of three different ones depending on the screen. Required fields are marked before you press Save. Financial statements show negatives in accounting parentheses. The General Ledger, journal list and cheque register fit more rows on screen. Settings has an index at the top, so its 24 sections are one click away instead of a scroll. Empty screens explain what they are for. Filed documents carry the date they were printed. NAMING. The vendor is MoRaj Supplies and Consult — corrected throughout, including inside the installed program itself. There is NO database change in this release: your data and settings are untouched, and the upgrade is simply installing over the old version.
